### 旧様式（令和2年版以前）の扱い
- 令和2年版以前の Excel は印刷用の1シートだけで、西暦の列も「機械判読用」シートもない。行のラベルは和暦（「21年」「22」「元」「２」など、元号は切替わりの行にだけ書かれる）。そのため c010・c012・c013 は使えない。
- lib/yearseries.py：和暦の行ラベルが1年ずつ続くことを確かめ（全角数字を正規化、元号の切替わり〔30以上→元〕を許す）、最終行をその版のデータの最終年として、後ろから西暦を割り当てる。
- c009v：列を見出しではなく**値**で対応させる版間比較（重なる年5以上・一致率0.8以上の列のうち一致が最も多いもの）。旧様式どうし、旧様式と新様式の間にも使える。
- c009v の陽性対照（新様式の版で）：A6（2-2-3-1 の 83,315 → 83,815、69→70）、A2（4-7-2-3 の 3,953 など、70→71）、A1（5-4-4③、70→71 の直近5年）をすべて再検出。限界：値の大半が変わった列（一致率0.8未満）は対応できず、A1 の 1989〜2016年部分（71→72）は c009v では出ない（c009h では出る）。区分の分割（例：仮釈放者 → 全部実刑者）で、分割前の年だけ一致して誤った対応になることがある（71→72 の 4-7-2-6 が例。誤検出）。
bc4f2b5b48dcdb91d96d2c4d9ad635e0f406f53e.en:
### Handling of the old format (2020 edition (Reiwa 2) and earlier)
- Excel files in the 2020 edition (Reiwa 2) and earlier consist of a single sheet for printing, with neither a Western-year column nor a machine-readable (`機械判読用`) sheet. Row labels are in Japanese era years (`21年`, `22`, `元`, `２` etc.; the era name is written only on the row where the era changes). Therefore c010, c012 and c013 cannot be used.
- lib/yearseries.py: checks that the Japanese-era row labels run consecutively one year at a time (normalising full-width digits and allowing the era change [30 or above → `元`]), takes the last row as the final data year of that edition, and assigns Western years counting backward.
- c009v: a between-editions comparison that matches columns by **values** rather than headings (among columns with 5 or more overlapping years and a match rate of 0.8 or higher, the one with the most matches). It can also be used between old-format editions and between the old and new formats.
- Positive control for c009v (on new-format editions): A6 (2-2-3-1, 83,315 → 83,815, 69→70), A2 (4-7-2-3, 3,953 etc., 70→71) and A1 (5-4-4③, latest 5 years in 70→71) were all re-detected. Limitations: columns in which most values changed (match rate below 0.8) cannot be matched, and the 1989–2016 part of A1 (71→72) does not appear in c009v (it does appear in c009h). When a category is split (e.g. parolees → persons sentenced to imprisonment without suspension), only the pre-split years may match, producing an incorrect match (4-7-2-6 in 71→72 is an example; a false positive).

   この 5 年は件数が変わっていないので、分母の人口が変わったことになる。平成27年（国勢調査の年）は変わっていない。
   → 令和2年国勢調査の結果による人口推計の遡及補正（総務省）を取り込めば説明がつく（推定）。人口資料との照合は未実施。
4. 再犯者の図は、重なる年（53 年分）ですべて版の間で一致。

## Comparison between editions (c004, exploratory, 2026-11-16)
Scope: the reference material "Penal Code offences: reported cases, incidence rate, cleared cases, clearance rate, persons cleared" (9 editions from the 2017 edition (Heisei 29) to the 2025 edition (Reiwa 7), 1946–2024),
and the figure "Penal Code offences: number of reoffenders among persons cleared and reoffender rate" (2014 edition (Heisei 26) to 2025 edition (Reiwa 7), 1972–2024).
1. Reported cases, cleared cases and persons cleared (including males) for Penal Code offences for the 13 years 2002–2014 all became smaller from the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) (by about 300–500 cases or persons per year).
   Example: reported Penal Code offences in 2002 were 2,854,061 up to the 2021 edition (Reiwa 3), and 2,853,739 from the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) onward (difference 322). The "2,853,739 cases" in the text of the 2025 edition (Reiwa 7) is the revised value.
   Note 5 of the reference material in the 2021 edition (Reiwa 3) states "'Penal Code offences' include dangerous driving resulting in death or injury for 2002 to 2014.", and this note disappears in the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4).
   "Total (reference value)" (Penal Code offences + dangerous driving resulting in death or injury + negligent driving resulting in death or injury etc.) has not changed for the same years.
   → This can be read as: from the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4), dangerous driving resulting in death or injury for 2002–2014 was removed from "Penal Code offences" and moved to the reference value (a retroactive revision to align definitions).
   It is not an error, but no note indicating this change is found in the reference material from the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) onward, which makes it difficult to understand for people citing figures across editions. [Awaiting explanation → explained by comparing the notes. Confirmation with the responsible agency not yet carried out]
2. The 2021 value of "Total (reference value)" changed from 857,289 in the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) to 857,858 in the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5) (+569). Since the Penal Code offence value is the same, the revision is on the side of dangerous driving resulting in death or injury and negligent driving resulting in death or injury etc. The pattern of change is the same as the type in which the latest year's value is replaced by the final value in the following edition (the reason is not stated in the material).
3. For the incidence rate of Penal Code offences (per 100,000 population), in addition to the 13 years above, the 5 years 2016–2020 also changed in the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4).
   Since the case counts for these 5 years did not change, the population denominator changed. 2015 (a Population Census year) did not change.
   → This is explained by incorporating the retroactive correction of the Population Estimates based on the results of the 2020 Population Census (Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications) (inferred). Comparison with population data has not been carried out.
4. In the reoffender figure, all overlapping years (53 years) match between editions.

c908fcae94905c633d098b73afde1e3dc44133a7.ja:
### A. 平成14〜26年 刑法犯の遡及改訂（令和4年版）
- 平成15年版のあらましでは、平成14年の一般刑法犯は 285万4,061件（https://www.moj.go.jp/housouken/houso_2003_hk1_1.html）。
- 令和4年版本文（001387342.pdf）では、平成14年の刑法犯は 285万3,739件。
- 警察白書 平成16年版（npa.go.jp h16 F4001010）では、15年は 279万136件で前年比 6万3,603件減。したがって警察の14年値は 2,853,739。
- 差の 322件は、旧刑法208条の2による危険運転致死傷。
- 結論：警察庁統計は当初から 2,853,739 だった。白書だけが危険運転致死傷を含めていた。令和4年版で、警察の定義に揃えたと推定される。
- 閣僚会議との関係：犯罪対策閣僚会議（平成15年〜）の起点は「約285万」。改訂による変化は 322件（0.01％）で、この物語に影響しない。創造戦略2022（令和4年12月閣議決定）は白書の公表後なので、時系列上も因果は見えない。
- 政策的意図を示す文書は、見つかっていない。
c908fcae94905c633d098b73afde1e3dc44133a7.en:
### A. Retroactive revision of Penal Code offences for 2002–2014 (2022 edition (Reiwa 4))
- In the summary of the 2003 edition (Heisei 15), general Penal Code offences in 2002 were 2,854,061 cases (https://www.moj.go.jp/housouken/houso_2003_hk1_1.html).
- In the text of the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) (001387342.pdf), Penal Code offences in 2002 were 2,853,739 cases.
- In the White Paper on Police, 2004 edition (Heisei 16) (npa.go.jp h16 F4001010), 2003 was 2,790,136 cases, a decrease of 63,603 from the previous year. Therefore the police value for 2002 is 2,853,739.
- The difference of 322 cases is dangerous driving resulting in death or injury under former Article 208-2 of the Penal Code.
- Conclusion: the National Police Agency statistics were 2,853,739 from the outset. Only the white paper included dangerous driving resulting in death or injury. It is inferred that the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) aligned with the police definition.
- Relation to the Ministerial Meeting: the starting point of the Ministerial Meeting on Crime Countermeasures (from 2003) is "about 2.85 million". The change due to the revision is 322 cases (0.01%) and does not affect this narrative. The Creation Strategy 2022 (Cabinet decision, December 2022) came after the publication of the white paper, so no causal link can be seen chronologically either.
- No document indicating a policy purpose has been found.

066daa8c24d467c9bff910a4e82f85081c778532.ja:
### B. 発生率 2016〜2020 の改訂（令和4年版）
- 総務省は令和2年国勢調査に基づき、2015年11月〜2020年9月の人口を補間補正している（stat.go.jp/data/jinsui/2.htm, 2-6.html）。
- 結論：分母の人口が技術的に更新された。政策との関連はない。
066daa8c24d467c9bff910a4e82f85081c778532.en:
### B. Revision of incidence rates for 2016–2020 (2022 edition (Reiwa 4))
- Based on the 2020 Population Census, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications has applied an interpolation correction to the population for November 2015 to September 2020 (stat.go.jp/data/jinsui/2.htm, 2-6.html).
- Conclusion: the population denominator was technically updated. There is no connection to policy.

9b2beea61967dcc0d922592127a5de7534f38f6c.ja:
### 判定
いずれも「推定」。法務総合研究所への照会で、改訂の理由と、注を削除した経緯を確認する余地がある。論点は、改訂そのものではなく、改訂を明記していないこと。
9b2beea61967dcc0d922592127a5de7534f38f6c.en:
### Judgment
Both are "inferred". There is room to confirm, through an inquiry to the Research and Training Institute, the reason for the revision and the circumstances in which the note was deleted. The issue is not the revision itself, but that the revision is not explicitly stated.

  - Example: for 1989, against A=5,205 and a breakdown sum of 1,421, Total=1,168 and B/A=7.21% (the values of Table ①). Correctly, the total is 1,421 and B/A is 27.30%.
- The `※閲覧用` sheet of edition 70 is correct (1,421). Therefore, it is inferred that the error entered during conversion to the machine-readable format.
- It was corrected in edition 72 without a note. Rows from 2017 onward are correct in both editions.
- Impact: when the machine-readable data are used, the revocation rate is underestimated as about 4–7% instead of about 25%, i.e. at about 1/4.
- Reproduction: c009_revisions_all.tsv, and the script in this section (checking the sum of the 5-4-4 breakdown against the total).

### 傾向

- c011 (row-by-row comparison) produces many false positives due to layout differences and cannot be used. It was replaced by c012 (comparison of occurrence counts across whole sheets).

### 新しい発見
- **A6（新規・二重検証済み〔別系統 R003〕）：令和4年版 2-2-3-1図の令和3年「勾留 認容（D）」が 83,315。** 正しくは 83,815。根拠：同じ版の 2-2-3-2表（閲覧用・機械判読用）と PDF の 2-2-3-2表（「83,815」）、令和5〜7年版の 2-2-3-1図がいずれも 83,815。同じ行の勾留請求率 94.329％ は 83,815 から計算した値で、83,315 では 93.789％ になる。閲覧用シートと機械判読用シートの両方が 83,315。正誤表にはない。令和5年版で、説明なく直っている。確実さ：確定。検出：c010（比率の再計算）→ c009h（69→70 の改訂）→ 手で照合。
- **A4 の範囲の拡大（二重検証済み・文言を修正）：** 2-2-3-2表の残存行（68〜104行の37行）は、令和3年版（R2 のシート）、令和4年版（R3・R2 の両シート）、令和5年版（両シート）にある。3つの版・5つのシート。令和6・7年版にはない。値は令和2年の本体と大部分が一致するが（259セル中239）、20セルは異なる（例：残存行 2,346、本体 2,349）。令和2年の修正前の作業データが残ったかどうかは照会で確かめる。上の A4 の「値は令和2年のもの」はこの意味に読み替える（R003 で GPT が指摘）。検出：c012g・c010。
- **A7（新規・二重検証済み〔別系統 R003、追加課題で〕）：正誤表で訂正を告知した Excel の値が、公開中のファイルで直っていない。** 令和3年版の正誤表は、2-5-3-6表 Excel の「保護観察付全部執行猶予者」総数（7,411 → 7,410）、3-2-5-6表 Excel の「保護観察処分少年」総数（8,114 → 8,116）を訂正している。2026-11-16 に取得した Excel は、どちらも誤った値（7,411、8,114）のまま。同じ正誤表の「仮釈放者（全部実刑者）」（3,929 → 3,931）は、Excel の区分が違う（仮釈放者の総数 4,249）ため照合できない。確実さ：確定（取得したファイルの事実）。**令和2年版でも同じ**：正誤表（housouken03_00036）は 2-5-3-6表 Excel の令和元年末「保護観察付全部執行猶予者」総数を 7,969 → 7,968 と訂正しているが、公開中の令和2年版 Excel（67_20261116T094520Z）は 7,969 のまま。
- **B（パターン・二重検証済み）：覚醒剤の密輸入の押収量は、毎年、翌年の版で前年の値が上方に改訂されている。** 4-2-2-2表①の4形態（航空機旅客・国際郵便・商業貨物・船員等）の合計で、令和3年 912 → 1,014kg（令和4年版→5年版）、令和4年 567 → 664kg（5年版→6年版）、令和5年 1,978 → 2,246kg（6年版→7年版、既報）。いずれも改訂の注記はない。暫定値と確定値の違いと推定されるが、白書には書かれていない（照会事項）。
- **不整合（新規・二重検証済み）：令和4年版の中で、刑法犯の検挙人員が図によって違う。** 2002年の刑法犯検挙人員は、1-1-1-1図で 347,558、1-1-1-5図①の総数で 347,880（2002〜2014年の13年すべてで同じ食い違い）。令和5年版で 1-1-1-5図も 1-1-1-1図に合わせて改訂された。以下は経緯の推定： 令和4年版は、危険運転致死傷（平成14〜26年）を「刑法犯」から外した（1-1-1-1図の脚注4の書き換え。総数は 2002年 347,880 → 347,558 など、145件の改訂）。ところが年齢層別・男女別の内訳（1-1-1-5図③、3-1-1-4図）は、令和5年版で初めて同じ組替えをしている（2002〜2014年に1〜数人ずつの改訂、84件・53件）。令和4年版の時点では、総数と内訳の定義が一致していなかったと推定される。確実さ：数値の食い違いは確定。危険運転致死傷の組替えという理由は推定（R003 で GPT も「時期のずれ」は支持、理由は資料から決められないとした）。
- **候補：2-2-3-1図 平成16年（2004年）の勾留請求率 93.279％** は、同じ行の人員から計算すると 93.335％。5つの版すべてで同じ値。もとの人員か比率のどちらかが、別の時点の値と推定される。確実さ：候補。

### New findings
- **A6 (new; double-verified [independent model R003]): In Figure 2-2-3-1 of the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4), 'detention granted (D)' (`勾留 認容（D）`) for 2021 is 83,315.** The correct value is 83,815. Basis: Table 2-2-3-2 in the same edition (for viewing and machine-readable), Table 2-2-3-2 in the PDF ('83,815'), and Figure 2-2-3-1 in the 2023–2025 editions (Reiwa 5–7) all give 83,815. The detention request rate of 94.329% in the same row is the value calculated from 83,815; with 83,315 it would be 93.789%. Both the for-viewing sheet and the machine-readable sheet show 83,315. It is not in the errata. It was corrected without explanation in the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5). Certainty: Established. Detection: c010 (recalculation of rates) → c009h (revisions from 69→70) → manual comparison.
- **Extension of the scope of A4 (double-verified; wording corrected):** The residual rows of Table 2-2-3-2 (37 rows, rows 68–104) are present in the 2021 edition (Reiwa 3) (R2 sheet), the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) (both the R3 and R2 sheets) and the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5) (both sheets): 3 editions, 5 sheets. They are not present in the 2024 and 2025 editions (Reiwa 6 and 7). The values largely match the main body for 2020 (239 of 259 cells), but 20 cells differ (e.g. residual row 2,346, main body 2,349). Whether pre-correction working data for 2020 remained will be confirmed by inquiry. Read 'the values are those for 2020' in A4 above in this sense (pointed out by GPT in R003). Detection: c012g, c010.
- **A7 (new; double-verified [independent model R003, in an additional task]): Excel values whose correction was announced in the errata have not been corrected in the currently published files.** The errata for the 2021 edition (Reiwa 3) correct the total of 'persons given a fully suspended sentence with probation' (`保護観察付全部執行猶予者`) in the Excel for Table 2-5-3-6 (7,411 → 7,410) and the total of 'juveniles placed on probation' (`保護観察処分少年`) in the Excel for Table 3-2-5-6 (8,114 → 8,116). In the Excel files retrieved on 2026-11-16, both still have the erroneous values (7,411, 8,114). 'Parolees (persons with fully executed sentences)' (`仮釈放者（全部実刑者）`) in the same errata (3,929 → 3,931) cannot be checked because the Excel uses a different category (total parolees 4,249). Certainty: Established (fact about the retrieved files). **The same applies to the 2020 edition (Reiwa 2)**: the errata (housouken03_00036) correct the end-of-2019 total of 'persons given a fully suspended sentence with probation' in the Excel for Table 2-5-3-6 from 7,969 → 7,968, but the currently published 2020 edition (Reiwa 2) Excel (67_20261116T094520Z) still shows 7,969.
- **B (pattern; double-verified): For stimulant smuggling, the seized quantity for the previous year is revised upward every year in the following year's edition.** For the sum of the 4 modes in Table 4-2-2-2① (air passengers, international mail, commercial cargo, crew members etc.): 2021, 912 → 1,014 kg (2022 edition (Reiwa 4) → 2023 edition (Reiwa 5)); 2022, 567 → 664 kg (2023 edition (Reiwa 5) → 2024 edition (Reiwa 6)); 2023, 1,978 → 2,246 kg (2024 edition (Reiwa 6) → 2025 edition (Reiwa 7), previously reported). None of these has a note of the revision. This is inferred to reflect the difference between preliminary and final values, but the white paper does not state this (open query).
- **Inconsistency (new; double-verified): Within the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4), the number of persons cleared for Penal Code offences differs between figures.** The number of persons cleared for Penal Code offences in 2002 is 347,558 in Figure 1-1-1-1 and 347,880 in the total of Figure 1-1-1-5① (the same discrepancy in all 13 years 2002–2014). In the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5), Figure 1-1-1-5 was also revised to match Figure 1-1-1-1. The following is an inferred account of how this arose: the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) removed dangerous driving causing death or injury (2002–2014) from 'Penal Code offences' (rewriting of footnote 4 of Figure 1-1-1-1; the totals were revised, e.g. 2002 347,880 → 347,558, 145 revisions). However, the breakdowns by age group and by sex (Figure 1-1-1-5③, Figure 3-1-1-4) underwent the same reclassification only in the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5) (revisions of one to several persons each in 2002–2014; 84 and 53 revisions). At the time of the 2022 edition (Reiwa 4), the definitions of the totals and of the breakdowns are inferred not to have matched. Certainty: the numerical discrepancy is Established. The reason, the reclassification of dangerous driving causing death or injury, is Inferred (in R003, GPT also supported the 'timing mismatch' but found that the reason cannot be determined from the materials).
- **Candidate: the detention request rate of 93.279% for 2004 in Figure 2-2-3-1** is 93.335% when calculated from the counts in the same row. The value is the same in all 5 editions. Either the underlying counts or the rate is inferred to be a value from a different point in time. Certainty: Candidate.

### New findings (grade A: errors in numbers or notation; all in machine-readable sheets of the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5))
- A2: The row for 2021 in Figure 4-7-2-3 (Trends in year-end inmate population and occupancy rate of penal institutions (female)). The machine-readable sheet gives an inmate population of 3,953, sentenced 3,402, unsentenced 551 and an occupancy rate of 60.9%. The for-viewing sheet gives 3,913, 3,394, 519 and 60.3%.
